component.name: RaptorCode
component.summary: Rust-native autonomous AI coding agent CLI

description.p: RaptorCode is a local-first supervised AI coding terminal from RaptorLabs.dev for building, reviewing, and testing agentic software workflows with developer supervision.
It installs the raptor and raptorcode commands for Linux users and supports supervised agentic coding workflows from the terminal.
